% Real PDF fixture: two distinct running marks survive sequential assessments.
% Both parities, plain pages, automatic blanks and chapter openers are covered.
\documentclass[11pt,twoside,openright]{book}
\input{config/book-config.tex}
\newif\ifBookTwoInkProof
\ifdefined\PageStylesPrint
  \BookTwoInkProoftrue
\else
  \BookTwoInkProoffalse
\fi
\newif\ifPrintThreeInk
\PrintThreeInkfalse
\usepackage{styles/universalbook}
% Expose the standard right mark through the ordinary label as well as the
% left mark through the ordinary title. This observes both mark components.
\renewcommand{\BookHeaderUnitLabel}{\rightmark}
\begin{document}
\setcounter{chapter}{1}
\markboth{ORIGINALLEFT}{ORIGINALRIGHT}
BODYNORMALONE
\clearpage
BODYNORMALTWO
\begin{Assessment}{ASSESSMENTONE}
BODYFIRSTONE
\newpage
BODYFIRSTTWO
\end{Assessment}
BODYAFTERFIRST
\clearpage
\begin{Assessment}{ASSESSMENTTWO}
BODYSECONDONE
\newpage
BODYSECONDTWO
\end{Assessment}
BODYAFTERSECOND
\clearpage
% A subsequent ordinary markright must retain the original left component.
\markright{NEXTRIGHT}
BODYAFTERMARKRIGHT
\clearpage
BODYMARKRIGHTEVEN
\clearpage
\thispagestyle{plain}
BODYPLAIN
\clearpage
% At this point the next page is even: cleardoublepage must insert an empty
% verso rather than accidentally retaining a running header or a page number.
\cleardoublepage
\BookChapter{CHAPTEROPENER}{BODYCHAPTER}{\item A short fixture goal.}
BODYAFTERCHAPTER
\clearpage
\thispagestyle{empty}
BODYEXPLICITEMPTY
\begin{Assessment}{ASSESSMENTFINAL}
BODYFINALASSESSMENT
\end{Assessment}
\end{document}
